Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

Interface Having

All Known Implementing Classes:
Having.Basic, Having.Between, Having.Nested, Having.NotNull, Having.Null, Having.Raw
@Internal public interface Having
One condition of a having clause, as the Builder records it and a QueryGrammar compiles it.

Conjunctions, values and the choice of final classes over records follow the same rules as Where.

API Note:
Internal: read by dialect grammars; may change without notice.
